traits.name: Ghost Hunter
traits.text: The duskwalker's weapons have the benefits of the ghost touch property rune on attacks against incorporeal undead.

traits.name: Hunt Prey
traits.text: ⬻ The duskwalker designates as its prey a single creature that it can see and hear or that it is Tracking. It gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks when it Seeks its prey and a +2 circumstance bonus to Survival checks when it Tracks its prey. It also ignores the penalty for making ranged attacks within its second range increment against its prey. Lastly, it gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Deception checks, Intimidation checks, and Stealth checks against its prey and to any check to Recall Knowledge about its prey, as well as a +1 circumstance bonus to AC against its prey's attacks. The duskwalker can have only one prey designated at a time.

traits.name: Hunted Shot
traits.text: ⬻ Frequency once per round Effect The duskwalker makes two longbow Strikes against its hunted prey. If both Strikes hit, combine their damage for the purpose of resistances and weaknesses.
